name: &TEAM vs FANTASTICS
overview:
Popular boy bands currently in the spotlight: &TEAM and FANTASTICS

They’re rapidly rising to stardom, but as stars, they should be able to gracefully overcome any impossible challenge!

Which group is worthy of being the ultimate star?

They’ll face off in a serious showdown

in an “original competition” that tests their group bond!

Plus, the winning team’s “MVP” will become the show’s producer

and produce a “reward special”!

Don’t miss this exclusive showdown between the two groups—a serious battle you can only see here!
